build_sequence_scorer: build a SequenceScorer instance with a target dictionary and optional softmax batch size
run_generate_scoring: run the generate method to score a batch of translations using an ensemble of models
review_batch_for_softmax: review the batch_for_softmax helper that chunks decoder output for memory-efficient softmax computation
review_gather_target_probs: review the gather_target_probs helper that extracts probabilities for target token indices
test_alignment_extraction: test the SequenceScorer generate method with compute_alignment enabled to extract hard alignments
